summary: dossier-retro-skipped-mislabel (PR #389) stopped NEW dossiers from recording a declined verdict as a skip: a phase that RAN and returned non-PASS after the floor verdict was set now lands in phases_run_verdict_not_adopted, not skipped_phases. The fix is FORWARD-ONLY and carries no version discriminator, so roughly 90 historical dossiers in knowledge-base/cycles/ still say `skipped_phases:[{phase:retro,reason:FAIL}]` for cycles whose retrospective-report.md is on disk. Any consumer that reads the corpus to learn which judgment phases executed — the disposition assembler is the one that matters — still gets the wrong answer for every pre-fix cycle. Decide deliberately between the two honest options rather than leaving it: (a) a one-shot backfill that rewrites the affected records, cross-checked against the presence of the run artifact rather than guessed from the reason string; or (b) a schema_version discriminator so consumers can tell a pre-fix record from a post-fix one and degrade rather than believe it. Do NOT do both.
title: ~90 committed dossiers still claim retro was SKIPPED when it ran — the mislabel fix is forward-only and the disposition assembler still reads the poisoned corpus
